## Connection {#Sisk_Core_Entity_HttpHeaderCollection_Connection}

Gets the value of the HTTP Connection header. To set this header in a HTTP response, use the
[KeepAlive](https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.Core.Http.HttpServerConfiguration.KeepAlive.md) property.

```csharp
public string? Connection { get; }
```
